text:
Ava: Heads up — saw a short 502 burst hitting /v1/generate at ~2026-03-18T14:12Z. spikes to ~0.6% for 1m in the ingress dashboard. Can someone point me to the fastest way to grab sample traces + logs to show infra/platform? also thinking we should propose a short alert debounce.

Diego: Which timeframe exactly? I can pull traces if you give me a request_id or the minute window. Grafana dashboard: https://grafana.internal/d/ingress/errors - Ingress > Errors by route. For traces use Tempo: trace query 'http.status_code:502' or filter by service=ingress and status=502.

Ava: timeframe 14:11:30–14:13:00 UTC. I don't have a request_id yet.

Mina: Also check kvcache.timeouts and prefix_cache.miss_ratio on the same window — we've seen 502 propagation when kvcache timeouts spike. Loki quick query: `{app="router"} |= "status=502" | json | line_format "{{.request_id}} {{.msg}}"`

Jordan: Quick how-to: in Grafana -> Explore -> Traces, set service=ingress, add filter `http.status_code=502`, sort by timestamp desc. For logs: Explore -> Logs, use label `job="router"` and `|~"502|504"`. Grab the top 5 request_ids.

deploy-bot: deploy:release/infra-gateway v2.14.3 promoted at 2026-03-18T12:45Z (no errors).

Ava: here's one request_id I found in logs: req-9f3a7c2b. Diego can you pull the trace and attach a flame/stack?

Diego: grabbing it now. If we want to avoid pager noise propose temp debounce on alert rule `ingress_error_rate_route` to 10m with 3/5m evaluation.

SRE-Bot: I can mute the alert rule for 15m if you confirm. Use `/sre mute ingress_error_rate_route 15m` to proceed.

Ava: yes please mute for 15m while we investigate. I'll post any findings.

Diego: posted trace snippet and two spans showing backend timeout at 14:12:05 (stack excerpt). Looks like upstream 504 -> translated 502 by edge. Adding note to ticket ENV-4132.

Mina: If kvcache shows even small spike correlate, we should roll back the kernel param we toggled last week. I'll check.

Ava: thanks all — will keep thread updated. :thumbsup:
